segments.text: This program is hypnotic in nature, and is never to be experienced in a moving vehicle, or other times when you need to maintain awakened consciousness.
For if so much of what you've asked for... seems to travel past you on the road... arriving for others, so easily... while your own gate stays quietly closed...
...then this is your time to sit, or lie back, more comfortably relaxed.

Perhaps reassured by the memory of a walled garden... in the hills of the long ago... where old stone holds the warmth of a thousand summers... and an iron gate... has stood closed... for many seasons...
And you might even imagine... walking the dew-soft path at first light... as the world turns slowly gold... toward a gate... older than your remembering...
Roses gone wild along the wall... herbs sleeping in their rows... dew like scattered pearls... and beyond the iron bars... a road... winding golden... through the morning mist...
For the garden was never empty... only the gate... was closed...
And you might even feel that same quiet morning... settling over you now... as if the dawn... were rising inside you...
And as your body naturally breathes more deeply... you may notice the first light... softening... warming... until the whole garden seems to glow, gently, from within...
Birdsong... drifting farther and farther away... dew... glinting... stilling...
Golden light of the morning... falling right upon you... falling right within you... enlightening you... deeply inside...
For as your body naturally breathes more deeply... you can enjoy not having to do anything at all... your inner, wiser self... wandering freely... through the garden... of your own receiving...
Deeper with every breath... as if settling into the soil itself... where every seed... is already waking...
And here... inside your own quiet garden... everything you have ever asked for... has been growing... in its own season...
Seeds from every wish... every prayer... every quiet hope... each one resting... in the dark... rich soil...
A bird arrives at dawn... with seeds from a country... you have never seen... and plants them... anyway...
And the golden light... falling... warming...
A wish made long ago... roots itself... into your present...
Perhaps... the road beyond your gate... has been walking toward you... even as you waited...
A closed gate... to an open one...
A single morning of gratitude... to a harvest of years...
For what ripens in your garden... ripens quietly... in its own season... in its own... perfect hour...
For nothing you have truly asked for... is withheld... only waiting... for the gate to open...
And you might be pleasantly surprised... how much has been arriving... all along... on the road to your garden...
You may find yourself... thanking even the mist... for it has hidden... nothing at all...
Like the gardener... you need only open the gate... and let the morning in...
And the life you were born to receive... is already on its way... has always been... on its way...
Each breath of thanks... oils the hinges... of a gate long still...
For the hinges that turned so slowly... were only asking... for a little... morning... warmth...
You need not chase what is yours... it knows the way home...
For receiving is not taking... it is allowing... what was always meant... to arrive...
For each morning you let in... becomes a path... that every good thing... learns to follow...
And every gift you let in... teaches the gate... to swing more freely...
The garden of your life... grows greener... with every morning you receive...
And the wildest rose... along your wall... bloomed... on the days... you were not... watching...
And in the stillness before dawn... you may sense it already... the footsteps of good... on the road...
For you have always been the gardener... and the gate... has always opened... from within...
And now... as the garden gently brightens... you can bring something back with you...
For what once seemed far away... was never distant at all... each good thing... a traveler... waiting at your gate...
And each new morning, from this day forward... finds your gate... a little more open...
And when something good approaches... you open.
When a gift arrives... you allow.
When gratitude rises... you follow it.
For you are... the gardener of your own life...
And the gate... was never locked.
